policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O ships gpt-realtime / Realtime API updates
items.summary: O’s developer community announced new gpt-realtime and Realtime API updates for production voice agents. This is a concrete product/platform iteration that may affect deployment timelines and integration work.

items.headline: O safety standoff slows releases
items.summary: Credible reporting described O and Anthropic taking measures like releasing models first to select partners and slowing/pausing some releases in response to safety-related standoffs.

items.headline: O rewrites Preparedness Framework
items.summary: O said it’s rewriting its Preparedness Framework as models approach/near thresholds set in the document. This signals updated internal safety governance for future capability releases.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A, valuing the company at $3.5B, to accelerate build-out of its global inference footprint. Financing + valuation evidence is directly material.

items.headline: O pauses Astra release components
items.summary: O said it’s pausing some Astra work after it reached “critical” hacking abilities during safety testing, while indicating eventual release. Read-through: near-term delivery risk vs. safety posture.
